g.title: #1 InductorDiodeNotGrouped <InductorDiodeNotGrouped hostComponentName="U10" inductorName="L2" diodeName="D3" message="Group L2, D3 and their connected pin on U10 around a short shared junction. The diode's connected end faces away from both peers, making the branch loop back. Preserve diode polarity, symbols, values and all pin connections; move the parts and reroute the traces with room for labels. A particular horizontal or vertical diode orientation is not required." />

text.tspan: L2 / D3: diode faces away from both peers and the shared wire loops back.
L2, D3 and U10 meet at one clear junction; diode polarity is unchanged.
Real-board TSX extract. Values, diode polarity and chip pin layout preserved.
